g.text: Matched-size character development: probability and frozen inference
Same 512 paired TEST positions across contexts; sampled-prefix character PPL, not full-corpus or word PPL. Hard CALL keeps continuous readout. Lines: latency
p50; vertical segments: within-run p50–p95, not seed uncertainty. No optimizer updates during audit.
